q1_what_did_you_play: I played Bag of Tricks on Nibbit, spending 3 Sparks to place three 5-damage Bombs, then Spirited Away and Run Away! for 16 Block total.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Bag of Tricks with Duck and Cover and Run Away!, which would deal the same damage but provide only 9 Block and leave 1 Energy unused.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up playing Duck and Cover and left that card unused; it spent all 2 Energy to maximize Block.
q4_different_intent: No. With this hand, no different enemy intent would change the line: the three-Bomb option maximizes damage and restores its spent Sparks when the Bombs detonate, while Spirited Away plus Run Away! provides the most Block available without sacrificing that damage.
